{{Top}}
The '''Kerdos Company recycling plant''' was a [[Kerdos Company/Legends|Kerdos Company]] facility on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] which turned toxic chemicals into non-toxic vapors and other gases. [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] flew through the exhaust [[Fire/Legends|flames]] of the plant while being pursued by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>
